welcome.title: Welcome to xTheGospel Leaders
welcome.subtitle: A quick intro so you can get value from day one.

slides.title: What is this app?
slides.description: This app helps ward and stake leaders organize callings, coordination, and follow-up with clarity.

slides.title: What can you find here?
slides.description: You will find dashboards, callings management, notes, and practical tools for day-to-day leadership.

slides.title: Quick tutorial
slides.description: Start by signing in, choose your role, complete ward setup, and then review your dashboard and callings.

canon.dashboardSubtitle: Organize callings and teaching with calm.
canon.dashboardHeroNote: Open each section calmly. Nothing here is urgent compared to sacred things.
canon.teachingSubtitle: Prepare and lead class sessions with clarity.
canon.teachingHeroNote: Create a session to get a code and QR. Support audio will be available soon.
canon.bishopSubtitle: Oversee ward classes with a pastoral view.
canon.sessionAudioSummary: Audio summary to prepare the class before you meet.
canon.sessionAudioIntent: A brief guide for tone and pacing of the lesson.
canon.sessionImagePrompt: A representative image or slide for the class, sober style. Coming soon.
canon.sessionHeroNote: Review the plan, activate the code when ready, and teach with the Spirit.
canon.reflectionBody: Before you teach, think of one person this lesson might help.
canon.reportHeroNote: Review the summary calmly. Export the PDF if you need to share it.
canon.trainingGateSeekingTeacherBody: Hosting a live class session is available when your profile shows you are a baptized member. Complete your path in Profile, then finish “Teaching in the Savior’s Way” in the member app (Training).
canon.trainingGateTswBody: Before creating a session to teach, finish the priority training on Christlike teaching principles and practices in the member app.
canon.trainingGateCoreBody: Before joining a class as a participant, finish the priority training on the Restoration, Plan of Salvation, priesthood, and ordinances in the member app.
canon.sessionCreateSubtitle: Set title, organization, what you will teach, the specific class, and parts before activating the code.
canon.sessionCreateHeroNote: You can edit the draft until you activate the session.
canon.sessionWhatYouTeachPlaceholder: Topic, lesson, or reference (for example, Doctrine and Covenants 1)
canon.sessionClassWithinOrgLabel: Class or group within the organization

sessionClassOption.ss_gospel_doctrine: Gospel Doctrine / Come, Follow Me—For Home and Church

canon.sessionLiveHeroNote: Guide the current part and support participants with patience.
canon.analyticsSubtitle: Ward trends for the selected period.
canon.analyticsHeroNote: Use this data pastorally—not for judgment.

login.title: xTheGospel Leaders
login.subtitle: Tools for ward and stake leaders
login.infoText: Your session stays signed in on this browser until you sign out.
login.helpText: Need access? Ask your leader or administrator to enable an account for you.

participant.title: xTheGospel
participant.subtitle: Sign in with your account to join the class
participant.infoText: Your session stays on this browser; you will not need to sign in again every time you refresh.
participant.helpText: Use the same email and password as your xTheGospel account. If you do not have one, ask your teacher or leader.
